sentences.text: Anhuilong is a genus of mamenchisaurid dinosaur found in the Hongqin Formation of Anhui province, China.
The only known fossil of Anhuilong is a single left forelimb containing a humerus, ulna, and radius.

The discovery initially attracted little paleontological attention, but after the death of Ren Xinxin, Huang Jiandong, and You Hailu, a team from the Anhui Geological Museum examined the cast of the single left forelimb fossil and concluded it was an unknown species.
